supporting_observations.claim: WS-LMARTINS-01 repeatedly connected to the internal proxy at 10.40.20.30:8080 during the alert window. Sampled connections occurred at 13:36:11, 13:41:10, 13:46:05, 13:51:18, 13:55:49, 14:00:52, and 14:06:11 UTC.

Several of these proxy connections have similar byte counts, including roughly 9.7–9.8 KB sent and 43.5 KB received; the cadence and pattern are consistent with a periodic check, but do not identify what service or process generated it.
The available connection records identify the internal proxy as the destination, but do not show the external HTTPS hostname or the originating process for the periodic connections.
